title: SvgFeGaussianBlur
responsibility: Renders the native feGaussianBlur element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeGaussianBlur.children
inputs.description: A Svelte Snippet rendered as child content of the feGaussianBlur element, and only when the value is truthy; omitting it renders no snippet content. The component adds no validation and no wrapper around what the snippet renders.

outputs.name: SvgFeGaussianBlur
outputs.description: The feGaussianBlur element itself, rendered in the SVG namespace with every prop other than children spread onto it as an attribute and the children snippet rendered inside it when provided. No wrapper element is added, and the spread attributes are passed through without filtering.
